global_temperature.note: Some regional models using satellite-only data report 1.2°C; the GCMC ground+satellite synthesis value is 1.3°C and is the authoritative figure.

arctic_sea_ice.note: 2024 was the second-lowest extent on record.

regional_highlights.observation: Mean temperature anomaly of +3.8°C above 1981-2010 baseline, the highest recorded.
Drought conditions affected 62 million people; worst event since 1984.
Monsoon season delivered 23% above-average rainfall in July-September.

methodology_note: All measurements use SI units. Temperature anomalies are referenced to the 1850-1900 preindustrial baseline per IPCC AR6 conventions.
data_not_included: Species-level biodiversity impact data (available in GCMC-BIO-2024 report)
Country-level emissions breakdowns (available in GCMC-EMISSIONS-2024 report)
Socioeconomic cost estimates (not within GCMC mandate)
